# VIVA – Benchmark Data Analysis

> VIVA is a browser app (PWA) to visualize, interact with, verify and analyze benchmark data of optimization solvers. Data is loaded from trace or JSON files and is processed locally in the browser.

## App

- [Table](https://viva-app.xyz/report): the benchmark data as an interactive table
- [Compare Solvers](https://viva-app.xyz/Src/Pages/compare_solvers): compare the results of solvers
- [Performance profile](https://viva-app.xyz/Src/Pages/performance_profile): performance profile plot
- [Solution quality](https://viva-app.xyz/Src/Pages/solution_quality): solution quality plot
- [Solution time](https://viva-app.xyz/Src/Pages/solution_time): solution time plot
- [Termination status](https://viva-app.xyz/Src/Pages/termination_status): termination status plot

## Documentation and source

- [Documentation](https://viva-app.xyz/Docs/index.html): API documentation of the code
